description: Full details of one place to stay on noclegi.pl: description, address and coordinates, guest rating and recent reviews, check-in/check-out times, amenities, photos, and every room type with its size, beds, amenities and — for given dates and guests — its rate plans (price for the stay, board, cancellation terms, prepayment). With checkin/checkout it also returns the total price of the cheapest room combination for the guests and the booking link; without dates, `price_from` is the site's best 1-night price in the next ~90 days and the night it applies to. When the dates cannot be booked (sold out, minimum stay) `price` is null and the note carries the site's reason. noclegi.pl does not publish the property's own phone or email — bookings go through the site. Fetched live from noclegi.pl (typically ~1 s via direct fetch; up to ~20 s when it falls back to an unblocker). Result: { source, fetchedAt, query, page_url, object: { id, slug, url, name, type, stars, description, address, geo, rating, rating_count, checkin_time, checkout_time, breadcrumbs, amenities, photos, reviews, stay, price, price_before_discount, discount_percent, currency, price_for, prepayment, selected_rooms, price_from, availability_note, booking_url, rooms: [{ id, name, available_rooms, max_guests, area_m2, beds, amenities, rates: [{ price, price_before_discount, discount_percent, board, price_for, cancellation, prepayment, bookable }] }] }, note? }. Prices in PLN incl. taxes and fees.

checkin.description: Arrival date, YYYY-MM-DD (from today to about a year ahead). Pass together with checkout; omit both for undated results.

checkout.description: Departure date, YYYY-MM-DD, after checkin — at most 30 nights (the site drops longer stays).

children_ages.description: Each child's age in years (0–17), e.g. [4, 9] for two children — prices depend on ages. Default none.

no_cache.description: Force a fresh fetch and bypass this server's result cache (5 min). Default false.

object.description: The property: its `slug` from noclegi_search (e.g. 'apartamenty-apartart-zakopane'), its https://noclegi.pl/<slug> link, or its name (looked up through the site's search).

name: noclegi_object
title: Get one noclegi.pl property
